status: Current HRS upstream projection and callable interfaces. Word/OMML/template implementations exist in independent Bridge/WPS; gaps below describe this upstream analyze() IR only.
source_of_truth: report.md (UTF-8 original bytes), assets/ original files

block_map.downstream_mapping: template style map and section numbering
CommonMark/GFM inline and list normalization; preserve original source offsets
OOXML table layout and template style mapping

block_map.docx_target: w:tbl with w:jc alignment and optional table bookmark/caption
block_map.downstream_mapping: Map simple Markdown cells into real OOXML table; rich inline parsing and merged-cell promotion remain separate steps
EMF/native or PNG fallback rendition selection; drawing sizes

block_map.docx_target: borderless group table; each logical image row followed by a separate child-caption row
block_map.downstream_mapping: Original logical rows/columns, group identity and numbering remain unchanged; mapped reader supports paired and legacy same-cell captions.
safe raster/vector rendition for supported Mermaid subset
code run/lexical highlighting optional; no execution
show validation errors, never silently drop content
TeX to OMML and Word field mapping (implemented by the independent Bridge math adapter; not by HRS analyze)

other_fields.references: array of {kind:fig|tbl|sec|eq, target, line, start, end}; display numbering is NOT stored
other_fields.assets: string paths of assets used; does NOT yet include full MIME/hash/physical dimensions
other_fields.list_styles: array of {style, line, start, end}; actual list items remain raw Markdown
other_fields.diagnostics: messages with severity error/warning and original location
other_fields.objects.ids: maps stable object ID to source line, NOT rendered figure sequence number

hard_rules: Downstream never reads HTML preview as canonical source
Downstream does not edit report.md during analysis
Downstream must preserve sourceAsset vs preview distinction
Downstream must resolve references AFTER layout order and validate target kind
Downstream must abort or report unsupported structures without data loss
Downstream must preserve authorized user templates (headers, footers and cover)
known_gaps: no complete inline AST for markdown paragraphs/bold/links/lists
HRS analyze() does not emit OMML/Word fields; Bridge math/Word adapter owns them
HRS analyze() does not render DOCX or map styles; the existing Bridge/WPS template chain owns those operations
no per-asset MIME/SHA/index in Python analyze() result
no canonical font, page size, orientation, margins or print styles in IR
no stable per-subfigure ID or subfigure-level cross-reference
app.js / studio.py large orchestrators, not good long-term scripting endpoints
HRS analyze() has no template library or merge namespace algorithm; existing Bridge run-job/v2 batches and WPS native multi-source jobs are separate entrypoints
GFM cells still contain Markdown inline text; Word requires safe nested inline AST and cell formatting mapping

agent_readonly.mutation: Read-only by design; controlled writes use the separate explicit block_cli plan/apply interface.
agent_readonly.compile_gate: sourceContractValid is structural only; safeToCompile=false and preflight.complete=false. Use hrs check for complete text/assets preflight; downstream compilation remains separate.
agent_readonly.anonymous_block_precondition: get-block requires --expect-sha256 matching snapshot.text_utf8_sha256; anonymous indices are snapshot-local, not stable IDs
agent_readonly.duplicate_id: get rejects AMBIGUOUS_ID instead of selecting a candidate

object_index.gfm_with_no_id: not present in stable object index

unknown_extension_policy: Unknown roots remain in source/data.extensions with UNSUPPORTED_OBJECT_FIELDS; sourceContractValid=false. No silent unsupported compilation.
html_display_boundary: Safe HTML remains original Markdown source, not a new numbered object or Word mapping; HRS html_cli owns export/recovery

controlled_block_commands.apply_precondition: explicit reviewed plan SHA-256; current source/range/candidate/resources revalidated
controlled_block_commands.save: shared editor lock, history backup and atomic report.md replacement
controlled_block_commands.bridge: delegates to HRS; no independent block model

engineering_output_checks: render_profile.output_checks consumes existing IR headings; errors block output, prefix notices need explicit snapshot acceptance

html_cli.output: explicit new path; UTF-8 JSON receipt and nonzero failure
html_cli.browser: explicit local Chromium for CLI only; not required for GUI export

programmatic_browser.concurrent_open: rejected during another open/export or UI report workspace transition
programmatic_browser.scope: one full-source Marked/SourceMap/index; UI source/preview may project a topic; A0/plan/apply remain full-source; exports use explicit snapshot
programmatic_browser.topic_snapshot: topics returns documentId/revision/sourceSha256 and full UTF-16 ranges; topicKey/exportModules require expectSourceSha256; independent module HTML/ZIP; source unchanged
programmatic_browser.open_policy: Read the formal snapshot without a recovery modal; UI recent/explicit resume/startup use the shared recovery path, persisted drafts retained

agent_execution_rules.reads: summary and local ambiguities; source ranges require current snapshot
agent_execution_rules.writes: only explicit reviewed apply; plan/hash/resources/atomic-save constraints remain mandatory
agent_execution_rules.review: Word role/number-edit decisions remain bound to scan/candidate source; no evaluation truths
agent_execution_rules.metrics: deterministic conversion API calls separate from AI development/review; unavailable calls/tokens/time=null or UNAVAILABLE
agent_execution_rules.tests: feature catalog; real local service, component DOM, generated gates and Office/system acceptance recorded separately

module_export_transaction.writes: only explicit complete HTML/ZIP output; private temporary stages cleaned on failure/cancel/close
module_export_transaction.agent_source_scope: A0/block plan/apply remain full-source; focus is never a write boundary

report_workspace_ui.writes: Default independent workspace; explicit reviewed sync can modify frozen origin ranges using existing report lock/backup/atomic commit; stale source/draft/assets refuse.
report_workspace_ui.source: current confirmed formal or draft snapshot; resources revalidated around copy
report_workspace_ui.state: original save/draft/engineering mode; own numbering; return/resume; busy transition rejects concurrent programmatic calls
report_workspace_ui.limits: Two running jobs; bounded/expiring receipts, paginated list, reversible trash; copy outside global save lock

sync.dependencies: existing Marked/SourceMap footnote and link-definition ranges

report_workspace_ui.entry: engineering direct Word; <=1 H1 free switches in place to engineering review; multi-H1 or explicit independent-preview action creates/resumes workspace

installed_cli.delegates: Original A0/block_cli/html_cli and page ReportPreflight; no model client
installed_cli.optional: check/html require Playwright and a local browser; GUI does not

complete_preflight.scope: page text checks; CLI adds asset/snapshot checks; neither proves downstream Word/Office result

diagnostic_policy.output_blockers: Policy diagnostic codes, not current active findings.
diagnostic_policy.active_result: Read valid/safeToCompile together with preflight scope/completeness and diagnostics.

project_asset_ui.writes: Explicit UI only; purge permanently deletes validated recycle files, not assets/source/drafts; protects new live references and refuses stale snapshot/unknown paths/links; interrupted deletion is reported and resumable after fresh confirmation

export_result_ui.request: result_token from successful HTML/module/PDF store; Word retains /api/word/open
export_result_ui.paths: Only server-issued result tokens; no arbitrary path input; existing 24-hour result lifetime and file-existence checks

local_link_ui.scope: Explicit Windows user click; relative targets require a saved project base; absolute paths and file:// may open existing documents/folders
local_link_ui.effects: Native application/folder navigation only; no target content returned or imported, no source edits; program/script/shortcut targets refused

desktop_host.core: same App and existing CLI/IR/preflight/save/Word chain
